comments: 41132e2c: Initializes the process for updating patient movement records.
e2bb87c1: Declare local variables for processing.
bd8b71d8: Set flag indicating the process has started.
1caca2f8: Loop through patient movements to update records accordingly.
71dc9c6a: Cleanup variables and quit the routine.
94ad8e9f: End of routine.
10c7ae46: Start processing a patient movement record.
664b8d5a: Set the corresponding admission for the movement.
b505d0a5: Determine the movement type (admission, transfer, discharge).
4a1527f9: Skip processing if it's an admission without a previous movement.
e0e163ae: Display a message indicating incomplete records are being updated.
4b1dc4d2: Reset the flag after displaying the message once.
37371ed1: Call DIK to delete incomplete records.
3f772026: Assign ward information for the movement.
5803c285: Set division based on ward information.
7f38ea2e: Quit if the division is not valid.
c7987c58: Display update message and reset flag if not already done.
a3ee0e7c: Set the internal entry number of the surgery/inpatient file.
1f018286: Call to process discrepancy records.
64d9cce9: Loop through and delete records associated with the admission.
d547cc0e: Cleanup variables after DIK process.
5437dc15: Handles discrepancies in patient movement records.
6f3fd896: Declare DR for storing dynamic record fields.
abe5ac3b: Set the admission ID for discrepancy checking.
11ba6567: Check for existing discrepancies.
d199a159: If a discrepancy is found, set DGJTDA to its IEN.
a56de695: Process a change if it's a transfer and there is no surgery/inpatient record.
d34d01a5: For admissions or discharges without discrepancies, create new or check existing records.
06b57fda: Delete the record if it's an admission without a prior movement and a discrepancy exists.
28e7c93d: Handle changes for admission discrepancies.
d89d9fec: Process discharge discrepancies when previous movement data changes.
6ff41b08: For discharges without a previous admission, set up new records.
dc0b68d2: Quit if the movement is a discharge without further processing.
3950b482: Set discharge action code if an admission discrepancy is identified.
3bf5d4da: Process changes if surgery/inpatient 'P' and 'A' data mismatches.
72ee6368: Handle changes if there's a service transfer with differing service sections.
7c9454be: Cleanup variables after processing discrepancies.
b96e53ef: Setup new records for discrepancies and incomplete records.
bbcaa8b5: Find the latest patient movement event for the record.
003936cf: Retrieve division specific information.
c8b796f1: Get ward information for the discrepancy record.
80a6c453: Set the service connected to the ward.
4b7c0a70: Determine the service category for the discrepancy.
8c84f29b: Document processing steps for setting up records.
062e8940: Handle specific documentation requirements based on DGJTP.
d372d185: Ignore processing if the movement type is not relevant.
8823ff76: Skip file creation if already handled by another condition.
793f8fdb: Create a new record in the VAS(393) file.
64db8615: Set the status of the new record to 'INCOMPLETE'.
e02fe899: Prepare the new record for filing.
c3b947cc: Update fields in the newly created record.
0def0681: Execute the filing and updating of the new record.
73934e3f: Cleanup and quit the NEW tag.
c1d07288: Set ward and division fields for the document.
b340475c: Finalize the document fields and perform the update.
a1061950: Cleanup after processing the file.
b54f525f: End of the FILE tag routine.
84f43d29: Handles the documentation specifics for patient records.
a02f53ea: Retrieve the specific documentation code.
f839ffb4: Determine the documentation type based on the setting.
ff45c4fd: Quit the DOC tag.
c9455d00: Change the record details in the case of updates.
c11b0ecf: Check if the movement has an associated discharge.
add86427: Update the temporary movement variable if there's a linked discharge.
a89280cb: Set the movement time for the record change.
